mapper.select: SELECT pr.id, pr.persona_id AS personaId, pr.empresa, CONCAT_WS(' ', p.nombre, p.primer_apellido) AS nombre, p.telefono FROM proveedor pr JOIN persona p ON p.id = pr.persona_id WHERE pr.id = #{id} AND pr.deleted = FALSE AND p.deleted = FALSE

SELECT id, nombre, duracion_minutos AS duracionMinutos, precio_base AS precioBase, categoria, requiere_certificado AS requiereCertificado FROM proveedor_servicio WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = FALSE AND activo = TRUE

SELECT m.id, m.modalidad, m.costo_adicional AS costoAdicional FROM proveedor_servicio_modalidad m JOIN proveedor_servicio ps ON ps.id = m.proveedor_servicio_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE AND ps.activo = TRUE WHERE m.proveedor_servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.activo = TRUE ORDER BY m.modalidad

SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END FROM proveedor_servicio_modalidad m JOIN proveedor_servicio ps ON ps.id = m.proveedor_servicio_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE AND ps.activo = TRUE WHERE m.proveedor_servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND m.modalidad = #{modalidad} AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.activo = TRUE

SELECT COALESCE(m.costo_adicional, 0.00) FROM proveedor_servicio_modalidad m JOIN proveedor_servicio ps ON ps.id = m.proveedor_servicio_id AND ps.deleted = FALSE AND ps.activo = TRUE WHERE m.proveedor_servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND m.modalidad = #{modalidad} AND m.deleted = FALSE AND m.activo = TRUE LIMIT 1

SELECT d.id, d.proveedor_id AS proveedorId, d.servicio_id AS servicioId, d.dia_semana AS diaSemana, d.hora_inicio AS horaInicio, d.hora_fin AS horaFin, d.activo FROM disponibilidad d WHERE d.proveedor_id = #{proveedorId} AND d.servicio_id = #{servicioId} AND d.activo = TRUE AND d.deleted = FALSE ORDER BY d.dia_semana, d.hora_inicio

SELECT p.id, p.codigo, p.proveedor_id AS proveedorId, p.servicio_id AS servicioId, p.nombre, p.descripcion, p.tipo_descuento AS tipo, p.valor_descuento AS valor, p.fecha_inicio AS fechaInicio, p.fecha_fin AS fechaFin FROM promocion p WHERE p.proveedor_id = #{proveedorId} AND (p.servicio_id IS NULL OR p.servicio_id = #{servicioId}) AND p.deleted = FALSE AND p.activa = TRUE AND NOW() BETWEEN p.fecha_inicio AND p.fecha_fin AND (p.limite_usos IS NULL OR p.usos_actuales < p.limite_usos) ORDER BY p.fecha_fin ASC LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE promocion SET usos_actuales = usos_actuales + 1, updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{promocionId} AND deleted = FALSE
UPDATE promocion SET usos_actuales = GREATEST(usos_actuales - 1, 0), updated_at = NOW(), version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{promocionId} AND deleted = FALSE
